scope: NXS/CLTH version3 serialization for both topology types and nested constraint records.

validation.case_scope: Two synthetic topology fixtures in both endian modes verify header/version, source type, vertex count, nested final halfword and exact 162/166-byte output lengths. Serialization composes existing scalar codecs. Independent native assets and full cloth cooking/loading remain unvalidated. Logical/ABI recovery only, not Full72, bitwise FP or gameplay proof.
validation.private_constants: No private constant bundle required for this serialization sample.
